name: Kevin Coalwell
tagline: Brand designer who builds visual systems and scales them across every touchpoint.
bio: I build brand systems and make them hold up everywhere they land, and I have spent the last four years doing it inside a humanoid robotics company. Identity, print, environments, film, web, and product UI, all speaking one visual language, with enough technical ability to work directly with engineering.
about: I'm a brand designer who builds visual systems and scales them across every touchpoint. At Agility Robotics, where I've been since 2022, first as Creative Producer and now as Brand Designer, that has meant a top-to-bottom rebrand, a new website, trade show environments, sales collateral, and a cinematic brand film, all held to one consistent identity.

Working on humanoid robots means most of what I design starts as something genuinely difficult to explain. I interview engineers, figure out what actually matters, and turn it into something a person can understand, then make sure it looks and feels like the same company wherever someone meets it.

That systems thinking carries into product work. For Carnegie Mellon's Tepper School of Business, I rebuilt an AI-powered learning platform around a design system and handed it off to a TypeScript/React team. I read and write enough code to have real conversations with engineers about what's feasible, and I've worked with clients across the public and private sectors including Agility Robotics, Carnegie Mellon, TIME, National Geographic, Active911, and Oregon State University.
When I'm not working or chasing my kids around, I enjoy strength training, tinkering with my homelab, and chipping away at a Cosmere novel.

experience.title: Brand Designer
highlights: Managing internal coordination of comprehensive visual rebrand, serving as creative liaison between stakeholders and design contractors.
Led visual strategy for website redesign project, focusing on user experience optimization and brand consistency.
Developed comprehensive visual strategy for major trade show presence, designing booth graphics and collateral that supported lead generation goals.

experience.title: Creative Producer
highlights: Cultivated the company brand, voice, and storytelling strategy, built trust and generated millions of engagements across digital channels.
Interviewed SMEs to translate highly technical topics into engaging content across a variety of touch points.
Managed creative contractors and sourced freelance labor.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
highlights: Redesigned the UI of an education web application, delivering modernized interface design, wireframes, and polished, developer-ready mockups that improved usability and flow while strengthening the UX architecture.
Built and handed off a comprehensive Figma design system for a TypeScript/React frontend, ensuring design consistency and a smooth design-to-engineering handoff.

experience.title: Brand Manager
highlights: Produced and published multimedia content across social channels to an audience of over 50,000.
Developed visual brand strategy for multimedia content in adherence to existing brand guidelines.
Interfaced with engineering teams to communicate software updates, new features, and tutorials to core audience.

experience.title: Video Producer
highlights: Coordinated with clients, drafted project proposals, conducted video shoots, and edited documentary and promotional content for Oregon State University in accordance with university brand guidelines.
